scripts.text: I was asked to collect some kind of research charts...
scripts.translation: 我收到委托，要收集一些研究员记录表...

scripts.text: - I hear somebody talking - - remote communication -
scripts.translation: - 我听到有人说话 - - 远程通讯 -

scripts.text: The status of the report collection is okay.
I'll immediately report the information related to the laboratory as a top priority.
scripts.translation: 实验室相关情报，我会优先立即上报。

scripts.text: Oh somebody has come! I'll call you again later.
scripts.translation: 哦，有人来了！我稍后再联系你。

scripts.text: Uh...? I didn't realize someone is here already...
scripts.translation: 嗯...？我没注意到已经有人来了...

scripts.text: Is there something you want from me?
Ask him about the tomb of honor.
scripts.translation: 询问关于荣誉墓穴的事

scripts.text: Return to the tomb of honor.
Say that Zeny is not enough.
There are many adventurers looking for this crevice, except for you!
scripts.translation: 除了你之外，有很多冒险者都在寻找这个裂缝！

scripts.text: If you change your mind, come back to me again!
scripts.translation: 如果你改变主意了，随时回来找我！

scripts.text: You also heard about the crevice that leads to that place, right?
scripts.translation: 你也听说过通往那个地方的裂缝，对吧？

scripts.text: There are many adventurers like you these days!
scripts.translation: 最近像你这样的冒险者可真多啊！

scripts.text: I entered this crevice for the first time and guess what? It led to a place where there are so many monsters swarming around.
scripts.translation: 我第一次进入这个裂缝，你猜怎么着？里面竟然挤满了魔物。

scripts.text: I gave a heads up to one adventurer I know. Then, he showed a high interest in it!
scripts.translation: 我把这事告诉一个认识的冒险者，他一下就来了兴趣！

scripts.text: He kept muttering to himself about biomedical research, labs something like that.
scripts.translation: 嘴里不停念叨着生体研究、实验室之类的。

scripts.text: He kept asking me to show him how to get there. I felt reluctant to let him know about this crevice because I didn't want others to know about it. But I traded this info for 100,000 Zeny.
scripts.translation: 他不断要求我告诉他怎么到达那里。我本来不想让别人知道这个裂缝，但最终还是以100,000 Zeny的价格卖给了他。

scripts.text: Not much later, he came back with his body thoroughly injured. It was a miracle that he came back alive... It was horrible...
scripts.translation: 没过多久，他浑身是伤地回来了。他能活着回来真是个奇迹...太可怕了...

scripts.text: However, he was holding several items. At first glance, they looked so powerful that even I felt scared.
scripts.translation: 不过，他手里拿着几件物品。乍一看，那些东西强大得连我都感到害怕。

scripts.text: After that, many adventurers entered this dangerous place through this crevice after hearing the rumor. I hardly found any adventurers coming out of this crevice again. Since then, this place has been called the tomb of honor.
scripts.translation: 之后，许多冒险者听到传闻，纷纷通过这条裂缝进入这个危险的地方。我几乎没再看到有冒险者从裂缝里出来。从那以后，这个地方就被称为荣誉墓穴。

scripts.text: I earned some money thanks to them, though.
scripts.translation: 不过，我靠他们赚了不少钱。

scripts.text: You want to know why I earned money?
scripts.translation: 你想知道我为什么能赚钱吗？

scripts.text: I found this place for the first time, so its ownership belongs to me as well! You got a problem with that?
scripts.translation: 我是第一个发现这个地方的人，所以所有权也归我！你有意见吗？

scripts.text: Hmm hmm... Anyway, give me 100,000 Zeny. Then, I'll open the door which leads to the crevice for adventurers like you...
scripts.translation: 嗯嗯...总之，给我100,000 Zeny。然后，我会为像你这样的冒险者打开通往裂缝的门...

scripts.text: There is nothing free in this world!
scripts.translation: 这个世界上没有免费的东西！

scripts.text: Let me see... one... two... three
Alright. Now that I received the Zeny, I'll open the crevice.
scripts.translation: 好的。既然收到了Zeny，我就打开裂缝。

scripts.text: I hope you can come back alive!...
What? You don't have enough Zeny, but you want to enter?
Hmm... Then... by any chance, you have a research chart?
scripts.translation: 嗯...那个...你手上有没有研究员记录表？

scripts.text: Hush, speak quietly. People around here may hear us. Do you have it or not?
scripts.translation: 嘘，小声点。周围的人可能会听到。你到底有没有？

scripts.text: Don't ask me why I need it. Just bring me 10 research charts. Then, I'll send you to the tomb of honor for nothing. What you do think?
scripts.translation: 别问我为什么需要。只要给我带来10张研究报告，我就免费送你去荣誉之墓。你觉得怎么样？

scripts.text: Go back to the previous menu.
You got any other business with me?
It seems 10 research charts are missing now.
scripts.translation: 看来现在少了10张研究报告。

scripts.text: Maybe you didn't pick them up from the warehouse.
scripts.translation: 也许你忘了从仓库拿出来。

scripts.text: Is there something else you want from me?
scripts.translation: 还有别的事要我帮忙吗？

scripts.text: Oh... yes, this is it... This is what I need... hoo hoo...
scripts.translation: 哦...对，就是这个...正是我要的...呵呵...

scripts.text: I'll send you to the crevice as promised.
I want you alive. See you again!
What are you looking for? Are you looking for the place where all the dead men roam?
scripts.translation: 你在找什么？是在找那些亡魂游荡的地方吗？

scripts.text: I can take you there if you want. You will need ^0000cd20 Sentimental Fragment and 150K Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation: 想去的话，我可以带路，需要^0000cd20个邪念碎片和150,000 Zeny^000000。

scripts.text: Or you can just see sentiment safely without the interruption of the dead. That will cost you ^0000cd30 Sentimental Fragment and 2M Zeny^000000.
scripts.translation: 或者你也可以安全地去感受情感，不受亡者打扰。费用是^0000cd30个邪念碎片和200万泽尼^000000。

scripts.text: Where do you want to go?
Where all the dead men roam.
What kind of place is it?
It's not enough. You need ^0000cd20 Sentimental Fragment and 150K Zeny^000000. I can't take you there for free.
scripts.translation: 不够啊，需要^0000cd20个邪念碎片和150,000 Zeny^000000，可不能让我白带路。

scripts.text: Good. You have everything. I'll take you there.
scripts.translation: 很好。你带齐了所有东西。我带你去。

scripts.text: But... I'm taking you there for money... you should be careful.
scripts.translation: 不过...我是为了钱才带你去的...你要小心。

scripts.text: So.. if you go inside, you'll see a ^0000cdStrange Machine that looks like a crystal^000000.
scripts.translation: 所以...如果你进去，会看到一台^0000cd看起来像水晶的奇怪机器^000000。

scripts.text: This machine will recover your HP if you use it. It helped me survive. I have no idea why it's in that kind of place though...
scripts.translation: 使用这台机器可以恢复你的HP。它曾帮我活了下来。不过我不知道它为什么会在那种地方...

scripts.text: I turned off the machine so no one can use it, but I'll let you use it as my special treat.
scripts.translation: 我关掉了机器，不让别人使用，但我会让你使用，作为我的特别优待。

scripts.text: Please be careful and use the machine if you need to!!
scripts.translation: 请小心，如果需要的话就使用机器！！

scripts.text: You've got all the items and money??
scripts.translation: 你带齐了所有物品和钱吗？

scripts.text: It's not enough. ^0000cd30 Sentimental Fragment and 2M Zeny^000000 are needed. I can't take you for free.
scripts.translation: 不够啊，需要^0000cd30个邪念碎片和2,000,000 Zeny^000000，可不能让我白带路。

scripts.text: Good. You have everything. I'll take you there.
scripts.translation: 很好。你带齐了所有东西。我带你去。

scripts.text: The exit is outside of the wall.
^EE0000Well, I also have a warning. Your location can't be saved in there, so if you log off or get disconnected, you'll be moved to your save point.
scripts.translation: ^EE0000还有件事得提醒你：那里无法保存位置，下线或断线后，就会回到记录点。

scripts.text: I dug in the ground to find something to eat and I found something even better.
scripts.translation: 我挖地找吃的，结果发现了更好的东西。

scripts.text: The living can't survive there. Only the dead roam around.
scripts.translation: 活人无法在那里生存。只有死人在那里徘徊。

scripts.text: There's a rumor.. that people who went there never came back...
scripts.translation: 有个传闻...说去过那里的人再也没有回来...

scripts.text: I was so scared but.. it became clear that it's a popular place for adventurers to visit.
scripts.translation: 我很害怕，但...后来发现那里是冒险者常去的地方。

scripts.text: The place I arrived at was ^0000cdnear Strange Sentiment^000000.
scripts.translation: 我到的地方就在^0000cd奇怪的思念附近^000000。

scripts.text: I ran away since so many dead men tried to kill me.
scripts.translation: 因为很多死人试图杀我，所以我逃跑了。

scripts.text: But then I got lost and fell down to a weird place.
scripts.translation: 然后我迷路了，掉进了一个奇怪的地方。

scripts.text: The place was the same as where the dead men roam ^0000cdbut there are only sentiments^000000. I was so scared, so I got out right away.
scripts.translation: 那个地方和亡者徘徊之处一样，^0000cd但里面只有情感^000000。我吓坏了，马上就逃了出来。

scripts.text: I will take you there if you give me the money and items.
scripts.translation: 如果你给我钱和物品，我就带你去那里。

scripts.text: You might go easier without his help.
scripts.translation: 没有他的帮助，你可能会更容易一些。

scripts.text: Please visit me any time. We have nothing to lose anyway.
scripts.translation: 有需要随时来，反正也没什么损失。

scripts.text: - You still have business to deal with here -
scripts.translation: - 你在这里还有事要处理 -

scripts.text: Oh! You want to exchange mind or grudge pieces?
scripts.translation: 哦，想兑换意志或怨念碎片？

scripts.text: You look like you have free time, don't you? Well, my business is slow these days too...
scripts.translation: 你看起来挺闲的，不是吗？嗯，我最近生意也很冷清...

scripts.text: One day, the guild master entered in my guild all of a sudden...
scripts.translation: 有一天，我们会长突然跑到公会里说...

scripts.text: '^1F294DI'll make all members in all guilds wear the Cloak of the Fallen Soldier!!^000000'.
scripts.translation: “^1F294D我要让所有公会成员都穿上堕落士兵的斗篷！！^000000”

scripts.text: As you know, this equipment requires a large amount of material, so all guild members had no choice but to be stuck in the dungeon and forced to work.
scripts.translation: 你也知道，这件装备耗费的材料可不少，大家只能被关在地下城里，没日没夜地干活。

scripts.text: You never know what luck you eventually may have. I flung myself into this digging work with determination and found so many rare pieces.
scripts.translation: 你永远不知道最终会有什么运气。我怀着坚定的决心投入这项挖掘工作，结果发现了许多稀有碎片。

scripts.text: Ms. Sub-guild master sent me to exchange things with others as a pile kept forming.
scripts.translation: 副会长女士派我去和别人交换东西，因为碎片堆积如山。

scripts.text: Of course, the amount of exchange was decided by the guild master emphasizing
scripts.translation: 当然，兑换数量是由公会会长定下的，他还强调说

scripts.text: '^1F294DI'll never accept it if it's below this amount!!^000000'...
scripts.translation: “^1F294D低于这个数量的话，我绝不接受！！^000000”...

scripts.text: Ms. Sub-guild master tried to throw dirt into the guild master's eyes. We really had a hard time stopping her.
scripts.translation: 副会长气得想往会长眼里撒沙子，好不容易才被我们拦下来。

scripts.text: I guess we can take care of it quickly if he adjusts it to a low amount. (sigh)... That's what happened.
scripts.translation: 如果他把数量调低，事情应该很快就能办妥。（叹气）...事情就是这样。

scripts.text: What?... I thought you were going to exchange it.
scripts.translation: 什么？...我以为你要兑换它。

scripts.text: Sorry. I don't have a choice because the guild master ordered it. You need {0} items, if he says no, I'm not at liberty to exchange it.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，这是会长的命令，我也没办法。你需要{0}个物品；如果他不同意，我就不能跟你兑换。

scripts.text: Would you like to continue to exchange it?
Thank you... I guess I won't be punished by the guild master, thanks to you.
scripts.translation: 谢谢...多亏了你，我想我不会被公会会长惩罚了。

scripts.text: Hey, buddy. Do you have some remaining Energy pieces? I'll exchange them with something appropriate if you want.
scripts.translation: 嘿，伙计。你还有多余的能量碎片吗？如果你想的话，我可以拿合适的东西跟你换。
{0}1 能量碎片 (2000 寂静E粒子)
{0}1 能量碎片 (1000 微弱E粒子)
{0}1 能量碎片 (500 不稳定E粒子)
{0}1 能量碎片 (500 邪恶E粒子)
{0}1 能量碎片 (50 堕落E粒子)
{0}1 邪念碎片 (50 能量碎片)
{0}1 怨念碎片 (666 能量碎片)

scripts.text: Normally he ignores me and goes on to do his work.
scripts.translation: 通常他会无视我，然后继续做他的工作。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I've got nothing to say. I'm just doing this because I can earn lots of money.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我没什么好说的。我做这些只是为了能赚很多钱。

scripts.text: Are you sure you want to exchange ^330066{0} {1}^000000 with ^CC33331 {2}^000000?
Well... if you don't like it, never mind.
No... No... you shouldn't do this.
You told me you would exchange it with {0} (item)s.
scripts.translation: 你说过要用{0}个物品来兑换的。

scripts.text: Oh thank you. Is there something else you want to exchange?
scripts.translation: 哦，谢谢。还有其他想兑换的吗？

scripts.text: When you have some energy piece left, come to me again.
scripts.translation: 如果你还有剩余的能量碎片，再来找我吧。

scripts.text: ^FF0000*You can obtain the Death's Chest when you give 3 of the same types of souls to the mind.*^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000*交出3个同类型的灵魂，即可获得死亡之柜。*^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000*You need 3 of the same types of souls to trade with the Death's Chest.*^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000*兑换死亡之柜，需要3个同类型的灵魂。*^000000

scripts.text: ^FF0000*You've obtained the Death's Chest. Would you like to continue the trade?*^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000*已获得死亡之柜，要继续兑换吗？*^000000

scripts.text: Kkk... I can... sense...the grudges...of countless...subjects...
scripts.translation: 咯咯...我能...感觉到...无数实验体...的怨念...

scripts.text: Where is... here?... here?... Aaargh... Who... am... I?... I cannot... remember...
scripts.translation: 这里...是哪里？...哪里？...啊啊啊...我...是谁？...记不起来...

scripts.text: I need... grudge's... grudge's... strong... power... It will help... both me... and you... all... Kkk...
scripts.translation: 我需要...怨念...怨念...强大的...力量...这对...我和你...都有好处... 咯咯...

scripts.text: Krrr... hehe... hand over... grudge's... grudge's... strong power... I'll enchant... a special power... into the helmet...
scripts.translation: 咯...嘿嘿...交出...怨念...怨念的...强大力量...我就将...特殊力量...注入头盔...

scripts.text: ^FF0000*If you bring Cursed Fragment, you can enchant it into the Old Helmet.*^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000*带来怨念碎片，即可为旧头盔附魔。*^000000

scripts.text: This is... interesting... In that helmet... there is no fragrance... filled with a special power... Do you want... destruction...? kkk...
scripts.translation: 真有意思...那顶头盔里...没有...特殊力量的气息...你想要...毁灭吗？...咯咯...

scripts.text: ^FF0000*Enchantment using Cursed Fragment is only possible in the Old Helmet.*^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000*怨念碎片只能用于旧头盔附魔。*^000000

scripts.text: How about... we begin... lightly?... Test... your luck... Kr..hehe...
scripts.translation: 先来点...简单的...如何？...试试...你的运气...咯...嘿嘿...

scripts.text: ^FF0000*Attempts enchantment to 4th slot. One of 6 statuses is randomly enchanted.*^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000*尝试为第4个插槽附魔，随机赋予六种属性之一。*^000000

scripts.text: Kr... hehe... Do... you like... your... first... enchantment?...
^FF0000*Attempts enchantment to 3rd slot. One of 6 statuses is randomly enchanted.*^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000*尝试附魔第3个插槽。随机附加6种属性中的一种。*^000000

scripts.text: Kr... hehe... Whether there will be... a door... to acquire... a much stronger power... will be... decided... now...
scripts.translation: 呵...呵呵...能否...开启...获得...更强力量...的大门...现在...就要...揭晓...

scripts.text: Once you succeed in Mettle, Magic Essence, Acute, Master Archer, Adamantine, Affection enchantments, it can be reinforced.*^000000
scripts.translation: 霸气、魔力精髓、锐气、名弓、金刚、恩爱附魔成功后，可以进行强化。*^000000

scripts.text: Kr... he... he... You are... lucky... I wish... you all the success!... Only then... will you come and visit me... with more grudges... I suppose...
scripts.translation: 呵...呵...呵...你真...幸运...祝你...一切顺利！...这样...你才会带着更多怨恨...回来找我...吧...

scripts.text: 3rd... level... reinforcement?... If you succeed... you will... gain... much stronger powers... but if you fail... you'll lose the powers... that you've gathered... so far...
scripts.translation: 第3级...强化...？成功的话...你会获得...更强大的力量...但若失败...迄今积累的力量...都会消失...

scripts.text: 4th... level... reinforcement?... If you succeed... you will... gain... much stronger powers... but if you fail... you'll lose the powers... that you've gathered... so far...
scripts.translation: 第4级...强化...？成功的话...你会获得...更强大的力量...但若失败...迄今积累的力量...都会消失...

scripts.text: 5th... level... reinforcement?... Are you... ready... to control... such huge... powers?... but if you fail... the result will be... worth... seeing...
scripts.translation: 第5级...强化...？你准备好...掌控...如此巨大的...力量了吗...？要是失败...结果会...很有意思...

scripts.text: 6th... level... reinforcement?... Are you... ready... to control... such huge... powers?... but if you fail... the result will be... worth... seeing...
scripts.translation: 第6级...强化...？你准备好...掌控...如此巨大的...力量了吗...？要是失败...结果会...很有意思...

scripts.text: 7th... level... reinforcement?... Are you... ready... to control... such huge... powers?... but if you fail... the result will be... worth... seeing...
scripts.translation: 第7级...强化...？你准备好...掌控...如此巨大的...力量了吗...？要是失败...结果会...很有意思...

scripts.text: 8th... level... reinforcement?... Are you... ready... to control... such huge... powers?... but if you fail... the result will be... worth... seeing...
scripts.translation: 第8级...强化...？你准备好...掌控...如此巨大的...力量了吗...？要是失败...结果会...很有意思...

scripts.text: 9th... level... reinforcement?... Are you... ready... to control... such huge... powers?... but if you fail... the result will be... worth... seeing...
scripts.translation: 第9级...强化...？你准备好...掌控...如此巨大的...力量了吗...？要是失败...结果会...很有意思...

scripts.text: 10th... level... reinforcement?... Are you... ready... to control... such huge... powers?... but if you fail... the result will be... worth... seeing...
scripts.translation: 第10级...强化...？你准备好...掌控...如此巨大的...力量了吗...？要是失败...结果会...很有意思...

scripts.text: Krr hehe... It's impossible... to reinforce... this power... The only way left is... to reset...
scripts.translation: 呵呵...已经无法...继续强化...这股力量了...只剩下...重置...这一条路...

scripts.text: ^FF0000*Mettle, Magic Spirit, Vigor, Bull's Eye, Adamantine, Benevolence
scripts.translation: ^FF0000*霸气、魔力精髓、活力、鹰眼、金刚、慈悲

scripts.text: You can reinforce the enchantment level only when the equipment is enchanted.*^000000
scripts.translation: 只有装备已经附魔，才能强化附魔等级。*^000000

scripts.text: However...before that happens... I need to check... whether or not you have... sufficient Cursed Fragments...
scripts.translation: 不过...在那之前...我需要确认...你是否拥有...足够的...怨念碎片...

scripts.text: Cursed... Fragments...{0} are... needed... I wonder... whether... you can afford... them?... kk... kk...
K...kk... It seems... you're not... ready to accept... such a huge power... yet...
scripts.translation: 咯...咯咯...看来...你还没...准备好...接受...这么强大的力量...

scripts.text: K...kk... are you... kidding... me?... How come... you... crave for... the power... with such a trivial grudge?...
scripts.translation: 呵...呵...你...在开玩笑吗...？怎么会...为了...这么点怨恨...就渴望...力量...？

scripts.text: ^FF0000*In enchantment, Cursed Fragment(s) 10 item(s) is(are) required.
Check the amount of Cursed Fragments you possess.*^000000
scripts.translation: 请确认你持有的诅咒碎片数量。*^000000

scripts.text: Krr.. hehe... It's... the power of the grudge... I think... this power... is strong... enough to...
scripts.translation: 咯...嘿嘿...这是...怨念的力量...这股力量...应该...已经足够...

scripts.text: ^FF0000*Equipment smelting level, card, equipment loss doesn't occur. However, the enchantment level may be downgraded, depending on the success or failure.*^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000*装备、精炼等级和卡片均不会丢失，但附魔失败可能导致附魔等级下降。*^000000

scripts.text: K...kk... It seems... you're not... ready to accept... such a huge power... yet...
scripts.translation: 咯...咯咯...看来...你还没...准备好...接受...这么强大的力量...

scripts.text: K..aargh...!! The power of the grudge... was driven... into a frenzy... However... fortunately it didn't explode because the power... was.... weak.
scripts.translation: 咯...啊啊！！怨念的力量...失控了...幸好...力量还弱...没有爆发...

scripts.text: K..aargh...!! The power of the grudge... was driven... to a frenzy... The power... which used to be... stable... also fell... one level down...
scripts.translation: 咯...啊啊！！怨念的力量...失控了...原本稳定的力量...也下降了...一级...

scripts.text: ^FF0000*Due to enchantment failure, it has been downgraded one level down.*^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000*附魔失败，附魔等级下降一级。*^000000

scripts.text: It... is a success. I can sense that the power of the grudge has become stronger.
scripts.translation: 成功...了。我能感觉到...怨念的力量...变得更强了。

scripts.text: This is... interesting... In that helmet... there is no fragrance... filled with a special power... Do you want... destruction...? kkk...
scripts.translation: 真有意思...那顶头盔里...没有...特殊力量的气息...你想要...毁灭吗？...咯咯...

scripts.text: ^FF0000*Enchantment using Cursed Fragments is only possible in the Old Helmet.*^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000*怨念碎片只能用于旧头盔附魔。*^000000

scripts.text: kkk... You look pretty calm... There is no power... contained... in the thing... I gave... to you...
scripts.translation: 咯咯...你看起来很平静...我给你的...那个东西里...并没有...蕴含...力量...

scripts.text: ^FF0000*This helmet is not enchanted, so it cannot be reset.*^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000*这顶头盔没有附魔，因此无法重置。*^000000

scripts.text: Kkk... You don't... like this power?... Bring me 10 mind powers... Then, I'll make this power... disappear...
scripts.translation: 咯咯...不喜欢...这股力量？...带10个邪念碎片来...我会让它...消失...

scripts.text: ^FF0000*You need 10 Sentimental Fragments to reset it.
All enchantments applied to the helmet, except for the smelting level of equipment and 1 slot card, will be reset.*^000000
scripts.translation: 头盔上的所有附魔都会清除，精炼等级和第1个插槽内的卡片会保留。*^000000

scripts.text: I'll... wait for... you... If you need me to... I'll wait for you... forever... kkk...
scripts.translation: 我会...等着...你的...如果你需要我...我会永远...等着你... 咯咯...

scripts.text: 10 mind powers... I will be... in trouble...
^FF0000*You need 10 Sentimental Fragments to reset it.
Check the amount of Sentimental Fragments that you possess.*^000000
scripts.translation: 请确认你持有的邪念碎片数量。*^000000

scripts.text: Fine!... I'll... reset... the enchantment... of the old helmet... I think... we may be able to absorb... a strong mind...
scripts.translation: 好吧！...我会...重置...旧头盔的...附魔...我想...我们也许能够吸收...强大的心灵...

scripts.text: K..kk... The power... of a strong grudge... has been... absorbed... Things I've lost... K.. aargh...
scripts.translation: 咯...咯咯...强大怨念的力量...已被吸收...我失去的那些东西...咯...啊啊...

scripts.text: Do you want... power?... If so, you... need to have... the old Helmet..
scripts.translation: 你想要...力量...？那就...需要...旧头盔...

scripts.text: If you... bring grudge's... power... I'll... give you... great power...
scripts.translation: 如果你...带来怨念的...力量...我会...给你...强大的力量...

scripts.text: ^FF0000*You need Cursed Fragments in order to enchant it.*^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000*你需要怨念碎片才能进行附魔。*^000000

scripts.text: Kkk... Of course... in order to obtain... great power... you may need... a countless amount of... grudge's... power...
scripts.translation: 咯咯...当然...要获得强大的力量...就需要...无数的怨念...

scripts.text: ^FF0000*Enchantment is proceeded in the order of 4, 3, 2 slots. You need 10 Cursed Fragments when you enchant each slot for the first time.*^000000
scripts.translation: ^FF0000*按第4、第3、第2个插槽的顺序附魔，每个插槽的首次附魔消耗10个怨念碎片。*^000000

scripts.text: If you have... the opportunity... you might be... able to upgrade... the enchantment level...
scripts.translation: 如果有...机会...或许可以...提升...附魔等级...

scripts.text: ^FF0000*When reinforcing the enchant level, 50, 70, 100, 150, 250, 500, 1000 Cursed Fragments are consumed, depending on the enchant level
increase after 20 Cursed Fragments in the 2nd step, and 40 Cursed Fragments in the 3rd step.*^000000
scripts.translation: 第2阶段之后消耗20个诅咒碎片，第3阶段之后消耗40个。*^000000

scripts.text: Can...you console... us who... are tormented in sadness?...
scripts.translation: 能否...安慰...在悲伤中...饱受折磨的我们？...

scripts.text: If you... can... do it... maybe... I can... give... you guys help...
scripts.translation: 如果你...能...做到...也许...我可以...给你们...帮助...

scripts.text: Weapon which appears... to be filled with... strong minds... our sadness... and resentment...
scripts.translation: 看起来...充满了...强大心灵的...武器...我们的悲伤...和怨恨...

scripts.text: If you... bring... one... I'll restore... it... to energy... pieces...
scripts.translation: 如果你...带来...一个...我会将其...恢复...为能量...碎片...

scripts.text: What kind... of mind... is contained... in this... weapon?...
scripts.translation: 这把...武器里...蕴含着...什么样的...心灵？...

scripts.text: You...have chosen... the weapon... which appears to be... filled with... strong minds... I'm... trying to restore it... into Energy Fragments... Do you... agree with it?
scripts.translation: 你...选择了...这把武器...它似乎...充满了...强大的意志...我...正试图将其...还原为...能量碎片...你...同意吗？

scripts.text: Do you have... any other business... with me?...
scripts.translation: 你...还有其他事...要找我吗？...

scripts.text: I have made... Energy... Fragment... by restoring ^006400{0}^000000...
- I got critical damage - - by mind's powerful wavelength - - which seeped into my body. -
scripts.translation: - 强烈的心灵波动侵入体内，我受到了重创。-

scripts.text: Do you have... any other business... with me?...
scripts.translation: 你...还有其他事...要找我吗？...

scripts.text: Can...you take back our souls again... tormented... in sadness?...
scripts.translation: 你能...再次带回...我们被悲伤...折磨的灵魂吗...？

scripts.text: If you... can... do it... maybe... I can... give... you guys... what... you need...
scripts.translation: 如果你...能...做到...也许...我可以...给你们...你们需要的...

scripts.text: ...I wish... you... can come back... to me again...
scripts.translation: ...我希望...你...能再次回到...我身边...

scripts.text: If you hand over... our soul...I'll make something... filled with... special powers.. using a combination...
scripts.translation: 如果你交出...我们的灵魂...我会用组合的方式...制作出...充满...特殊力量的东西...
